Great Lakes Family Dental located in Blissfield, Michigan provides high-quality dental care to Blissfield, Palmyra, and Rigs Townships in a cheerful and welcoming environment. Our dental office is conveniently located off US Highway 223. Patients chose our office due to our wide range of dental services, friendly and professional team members, and convenient hours including Saturday. Blissfield also offers complimentary nitrous oxide for the comfort of our patients.

Our dentists and dental specialists provide a full range of dental services in a comfortable welcoming setting. Preventive care such as digital x-rays and cleanings and more advanced services like braces and root canals are available in-house with no need for a referral.

Our Great Lakes Family Dental Blissfield dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services.
